body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> B&O(Bang & Olufsen) is introducing 'BeoSound 6' at upcoming CES 2008 in Las Vegas, USA. Adopting B&O's high-end audio technology, this mp3 player boasts 40 hours of playback. It features 1.81-inch TFT LCD and 4GB internal memory. It weighs 65g.
